explanation: Matches Conjecture 1 of Fernandes (arXiv 2605.12342): for m >= n >= 2 outside {(2,2),(3,3),(4,3),(4,4)}, rank(Γ_{m⊕n}) = 2. The Lean states 2-generation rather than exact rank 2, as the docstring notes; this is equivalent because the paper shows rank >= 2 whenever m > 2 or n > 2. `gammaSubgroup` is the kernel of sgn(σ1)·sgn(σ2)^-1, i.e. equal-sign pairs. Brute force confirmed 2-generation for (3,2), (4,2), (5,2), (5,3). The linked Lean development (github.com/KitaKen1/fernandes-conjecture-1-lean, commit c9360c5) states exactly this proposition; I read the wrapper, but did not check the proof. Faithful.
